open_graph.og:title: Color format converter - CSS | MDN
open_graph.og:description: This tool lets you enter or pick a color and copy its corresponding value in any CSS color format. You can use the generated color value anywhere the <color> data type is supported in CSS. This tool can also help you understand the syntax of the different color notations.
